data.one_liner: Monitor your Flutter app's FPS and performance metrics in real time with an overlay badge.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter widget that wraps your application to monitor and display real-time FPS, frame times, min/max values, and charts. It includes customizable alert thresholds, jank indicators, and interactive features like dragging and collapsing.
use_when: You need to monitor and debug frame rendering performance during development.
You want a visual overlay showing real-time FPS, dropped frames, and jank indicators.
avoid_when: You are running production builds where performance overlays should be completely hidden.
You need deep native profiling tools rather than a lightweight on-screen FPS badge.
strengths: Provides real-time FPS monitoring with microsecond precision.
Includes interactive charts, jank detection, and customizable alert thresholds.
Supports dragging, collapsing, and temporary hiding features.
weaknesses: Adds an overlay widget to the widget tree which may slightly impact rendering.
Limited to visual on-screen metrics rather than full memory or CPU profiling.
data.setup_notes: Simply wrap your main widget or MaterialApp with the ShowFPS widget.
